category_title: Adult students with high statistics anxiety and low math self-efficacy
scenario_title: Using statistical software for data analysis
minimal_context: The student is attempting to use statistical software to perform data analysis tasks during a weekly lab session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open the statistical software and begin the data analysis procedure for this week's lab.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Just looking at this program terrifies me. Yes, I am highly stressed about having to do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should click first?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I usually need my partner for this because their computer skills are a lot higher than mine.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to figure it out on your screen.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't, this just terrifies me too much. I'm going to stop and just let my partner do the software part since their computer skills are a lot higher than mine, which is the only thing that lowers my anxiety.
